#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Same absolute budget: single11 versus conditional8/11 plus three matched distributed controls. No training or CP.
set -euo pipefail
cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
source scripts/shell/tinylm_env.sh
PY="$(tinylm_python)"
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=4
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=4
exec "${PY}" -B -X utf8 scripts/runlog.py --num 108 --name P108_Stage21cW_distributed_residual_actual -- timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=20s 1850s "${PY}" -B -X utf8 -m scripts.diag_p108_distributed_residual actual
